The selected pilgrims shall pay a deposit amount of Rs. 500/- before 12:00 PM on 13.11.2026, to confirm their Angapradakshinam Seva.

Please [Click Here](/virtual-seva/seva-instructions?templeName=Sri%20Padmavathi%20Ammavari%20Temple&flowIdentifier=virtual-seva&flow=virtual-seva)
Booking for General Srivari Seva for Tirumala and Tirupati, Navaneeta Seva and Parakamani Seva for December-2026 has been completed.

Due to the heavy influx of pilgrims observed in view of Puratasimasam and consecutive holidays, the SRIVANI Current Booking will remains closed on Saturday(03.10.2026) and Sunday( 04.10.2026).
Pilgrims are requested to kindly make a note of it and plan your visit accordingly. Inconvenience caused may please be regretted.

Om Namo Venkatesaya
 
The Online Quota of General Srivari Seva for Local SV Temples of 
Hyderabad,
Bhuvaneswar,
Visakhapatnam,
Bengaluru and
Vontimitta for November 2026 will be released at 4 PM on 28.09.2026.
 
**Note:**
Only LOCALS of the above temples have to apply.
 
NO Accommodation/Transport will be provided by TTD.
 
**Reporting Days:**
General Srivari Sevaks have to report on the same day of their Seva booking date in the respected temple premises to concern reporting in-charges.
Darshan & Accommodation Quota to the SRIVANI Trust (Rs. 10,500/-) donors for the month of January – 2027 will be available for booking w.e.f 23.10.2026 from 11:00 AM onwards

Darshan & Accommodation Quota to the Trusts / Schemes Donors for the month of December – 2026 (Except darshan from 19.12.2026 to 29.12.2026 and accommodation from 18.12.2026 to 29.12.2026) will be available for booking w.e.f 28.09.2026, 11:30 AM.
To generate Digital passbook for the donations made before September 2016, please [click here](https://tirupatibalaji.ap.gov.in/#/donorPassbook)

The Advance booking Arjitha Seva ticket holders of Sahasrakalasabhishekam, Vishesha Pooja, Nijapada darshanam are requested to avail Break Darshan or to get refund instead of Seva for their booking made in advance. Please [click here](https://arjithaseva.tirupatibalaji.ap.gov.in/#/) to avail break darshan or to get refund.
To enable self service for the existing    donors, please [Click here](https://tirupatibalaji.ap.gov.in/#/donorSelfservice)
